ryan.m: Quick one  my spouse just deployed and the kids are moving in with me full-time while they're overseas. Can I add both kids to my Redwood benefits as a midyear change?

maria.peopleops: Hi Ryan  sorry to hear about the deployment. Yes, a change in household/custody for military reasons counts as a Qualifying Life Event (QLE). You have 30 days from the date the kids became your primary residence to submit.

ryan.m: Awesome. What counts as proof for a military deployment? Orders? Letter from command?

maria.peopleops: Common carrier-accepted docs include:
- Military deployment/PCS orders showing spouse's departure or reassignment
- Temporary custody or placement affidavit signed/notarized by the other parent
- Power of attorney for childcare (if applicable)
- School records, mail, or DMV showing child at your address for residency-based requests
If the deployment creates a temporary guardianship, the notarized guardianship + school record usually works.

benefits-bot: If you upload files via the portal or email benefits@redwood.com we'll create a case. Acknowledgement and case # will be posted here once received. Carrier verifications usually take 3-10 business days.

ryan.m: Any special handling because it's military? Do carriers expedite?

maria.peopleops: Some carriers are familiar with military QLEs and will expedite if documented. If there are urgent appointments, we can request a predetermination/coverage letter. Also note: if your spouses plan (through their military spouse benefits or civilian plan) remains active, COB may apply. We'll handle carrier coordination.

julie.legal: Quick legal note  temporary POAs and deployment orders are generally sufficient for carriers, but some require a dated custody/stay agreement. If you run into a carrier insisting on additional paperwork, we can draft a supporting cover letter referencing the orders to accompany your upload.

ryan.m: Payroll question  if added mid-pay-period are premiums prorated? Any tax impacts because of military status?

kevin.payroll: Payroll here. Proration depends on carrier effective date plus payroll cutoff. If the carrier agrees to an effective date equal to the move-in date and we receive confirmation before payroll locks, we prorate the deduction. If confirmation comes later, we process an adjustment. Military tax implications are rare for dependents; we'll flag for gross-up only if local payroll or international tax rules apply.

ryan.m: Great  I'll gather orders and the notarized school letter and upload. What should the email subject be if I email docs?

maria.peopleops: Please email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "QLE: Add dependents - military deployment - <Ryan M>" and attach PDFs. Or upload via People Ops portal > Benefits > QLE uploads. We'll ack and post the case number here. Ping this thread after you upload if you want us to nudge the carrier/broker for a faster turnaround.

ryan.m: Uploaded orders + temporary guardianship form. Thanks  please ping when carrier confirms.

benefits-bot: Upload received. Case #RB-2551 created. Expect carrier verification in 3-7 business days; we'll post updates here.

maria.peopleops: Thanks Ryan. We'll flag this as time-sensitive and request predetermination for any upcoming appointments if needed. :salute:
